children: Cayson Acquisition entered into a Strategic Cooperation and Services Agreement with Prisma Global to seek up to $1 million in working-capital loans before a business combination and introductions to potential sources of up to $18 million in financing alongside a business combination. Cayson will pay Prisma 10% of each committed working-capital loan, capped at $100,000, plus expenses equal to 5% of funded loan amounts, capped at $50,000; any fee for the financing introductions will be agreed separately. The arrangement is intended to help Cayson fund operations and pursue a business combination.
: Strategic cooperation and financing services agreement
: Obtain working capital and identify financing sources for a business combination
